'''2006 New Jersey State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship scheduled for Saturday 24 June 2006 at noon at the Lawrenceville Public Library, 2751 Brunswick Pike, Lawrenceville, New Jersey, organized by [[Scott Lingrell]].<ref name="sf-10071-140284">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140284#p140284 NJ States - June 24th, 2006], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (8 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052938/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10071 Internet Archive]</ref> It was an [[Open]] format event with a $10 entry fee and cash prizes, $100 of them to first place.<ref name="sf-10071-139168">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=139168#p139168 NJ States - June 24th, 2006], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (31 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052938/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10071 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-10071-140284" />

== Organization ==

Lingrell posted the details on 26 May 2006 and updated them in June.<ref name="sf-10071-138645">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=138645#p138645 NJ States - June 24th, 2006], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052938/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10071 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-10071-140284" /> He considered making it a [[Classic]] qualifying event; a player replied that the previous year's New Jersey state championship had drawn about 13 players and that Classic might draw fewer, and Lingrell then announced that "after some internal discussion" it would be Open format.<ref name="sf-10071-139155">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=139155#p139155 NJ States - June 24th, 2006], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (31 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052938/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10071 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-10071-139167">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=139167#p139167 NJ States - June 24th, 2006], dynamicdog2002, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (31 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052938/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10071 Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-10071-139168" /> On 13 June he reported a roll call of more than ten players, expected at least fifteen, and wrote that a player from 1999 was returning to play.<ref name="sf-10071-140983">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140983#p140983 NJ States - June 24th, 2006], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (13 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052938/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10071 Internet Archive]</ref> Players could stay overnight in a meeting room at his office.<ref name="sf-10071-140478">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=140478#p140478 NJ States - June 24th, 2006], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (10 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126052938/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=10071 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Lawrenceville Public Library, 2751 Brunswick Pike, Lawrenceville, New Jersey<ref name="sf-10071-140284" />
* '''Dates:''' 24 June 2006<ref name="sf-10071-140284" />
* '''Time:''' 12:00 pm<ref name="sf-10071-140284" />
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]<ref name="sf-10071-139168" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-10071-140284" />
* '''Prizes:''' cash, $100 to first place<ref name="sf-10071-140284" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]<ref name="sf-10071-140284" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the event's forum topic.
